text: Study the map and tell where should Shamrao send his crop? What factors will Shamrao consider for this?
context:
Read the following situations and answer.

1) Look at the map of Solapur district in fig. 5.2, which shows the location of some major sugar industries at Vairag, Akluj, Pimpalner, Takli Sikandar, Bhilarwadi, Bhalwani, Waki Shivne, Dahitane, Mangalvedha and Solapur. Shamrao is a farmer at location A. He has just harvested his sugarcane crop.

2) Firoz's son has done an advanced course in Bakery Management from the nearby city. Firoz wants his son to start a bakery in their village but his son says it should be in the city, which is around 20 kms from their village.

3) Shantaram is a young boy from a tribal area in Maharashtra. He wants to start a honey processing unit as he has access to good honeycombs in the forest. The city is around 35 kms away. He has his own land in the village and is also getting land in the city.

text: In which hemisphere do you find more concentration of industries?
context:
Study the given map in fig. 5.3 and answer the questions that follow.

Fig. 5.3 is a world map titled 'World - Major Industrial Regions'. Latitude lines are marked at 60 degrees N, 30 degrees N, 0, 30 degrees S and 60 degrees S. The industrial regions are shaded and named:

North America: N.W. Region, Western Region (Pacific Coastal Region), S. Canada, New England, New York, Mid-Atlantic Region, Eastern Texas.
South America: Venezuela, Eastern Brazil, S.E. Brazil, Argentina, Chile.
Europe: Scandinavian countries, Great Britain Region, Ruhr Region, Italy, Moscow-Tula-Vladimir triangle, North Caucasus Region, Ural-Volga Region.
Africa: Ghana, Congo, Zambia, Kimberley, Witwatersrand.
Asia: Siberian Region, Manchurian Region, Vladivostok Region, S. Korea, Tokyo-Kawasaki-Yokohama, Nagoya and N. Kyushu, Osaka-Kobe-Kyoto, East Coast (Beijing), Lower Yangtze (Shanghai), Middle East Region, Ahmedabad-Vadodara, Mumbai-Pune, Chhota Nagpur Plateau, Coimbatore-Bangalore Region.
Australia: Perth, Adelaide, Melbourne, Sydney, Auckland, Waikato, Canterbury.
Antarctica: no industrial region is shown.

Almost all the shaded regions lie north of the equator, and the great majority of them between 30 degrees N and 60 degrees N.
